Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

barbarian noun and adjective

also barbarous, barbaric, uncivilised, foreigner (not Greek or Roman)

classical

Cic. Mil. 30: sīn hoc et ratiō doctīs et necessitās barbarīs praescrīpsit (Lewis & Short)
Lucr. 6.37: quō neque noster adit quisquam, nec barbarus audet (Lewis & Short)

barbarus, barbara, barbarum

declension

foreign, neither Greek nor Roman; barbarous; as a noun, a barbarian

Greek βάρβαρος: to the Greeks whoever was not Greek, to the Romans whoever was neither.

Examples

  • quō neque noster adit quisquam, nec barbarus audet

    where none of our people goes and no barbarian dares toLucr. 6.37 (Lewis & Short)

See also foreign.
